title: Distance to affine signs and Fourier norm
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube with $|f(x)|=1$ at every point. Its normalized Hamming distance to the family of affine sign functions equals $\frac12-\frac12\|\widehat f\|_\infty$, where $\|\widehat f\|_\infty$ is the maximum absolute value of its Fourier coefficients.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the Boolean cube
